Direction des Services Fiscaux (New Caledonia): la Taxe générale sur la consommation (TGC) — VAT-type tax since 1 October 2018 with four rates (3%, 6%, 11%, 22%)
CCI Nouvelle-Calédonie: TGC rates — 3% reduced, 6% specific (services), 11% normal, 22% higher, definitive since 1 October 2018

caveats: individualTaxYear is the calendar year, inferred from the country's annual assessment cycle (grade I); not confirmed on the authority's own pages in this pass.
companyYearEndDefault is a 31 December app default for new entities (grade I), not a statutory requirement; companies may choose other year ends under national law.

TGC rates have applied since 1 October 2018. A simplification reform under consultation in October-November 2026 would replace the four rates with two (0% and 10%, or 2% and 9%); consultations closed 20 November 2026, so re-check before the rates move.
